workflow_pattern: This is a 'F7_pure_automation' style workflow. It requires the following operations, in roughly this order: create repository, add readme with content, create workflow dynamic content comment, validate automation with test issues. The task should combine these operations into one coherent, realistic request without listing them as separate steps.
question:
Hi! Can you please help me make a super cool project repository called owner-signed-bot? I want to start it with just the main branch! Oh, and can we put a special README.md file in it that says "# Owner Signed Bot

A repository to test GitHub automation for adding comments to issues."? That would be awesome! Then, I really really want to make a GitHub robot that watches for new issues labeled 'bug' and comments something that dynamically inserts the repo owner's name, like "Triaged by [repo owner name], thanks for the report." Remember to replace [repo owner name] with the actual name of the repository owner. After we build the robot, can we test it by making two pretend issues? The first one should be called "Login page throws 500" and have a bug label, and the second one should be "Improve onboarding copy" with no label at all and just get a manual comment "Hello, world!" This is going to be so much fun!
